method: All H×Q/B/M pairs, entire printed harmonic/pitch/rhythm joint cycles; V-target checks; then XYZ rectangles and referenced R rectangles at27cells+8corners. Actual existing C++ weight/Variety separately evaluated.
limitations: Formal under printed H context, not aesthetic hearing proof.
Local source collections beyond H are not silently unioned; rejected pairs may need explicit alternative scoped authorization.
No automatic transposition/voicing/role allocation to repair incompatibility.
Pairwise compatibility does not prove simultaneous Q+B+M or independent-pedal implementation.
Pulse-/melody-free output is valid; no requirement to populate Q/M in every cell.
No JC sources are active in the current engine.
